title: Notification regarding arrangement of Criminal Matters will commence from 05.05.2026
text:
KEY LINES:
05.05.2026.
04/05/2026

FULL TEXT:
NOTIFICATION
As
directed
by
the Hon’ble the
Chief
Justice,
all
the
LearnedAdvocates,
Litigants,
Party-in-person
and
Stakeholders
are
hereby
informed
that:
1. All
fresh
and
pending
matters
within
the
jurisdiction of
Twenty
Eighth
Court
(Coram: Hon’ble
Mr.
Justice
Utkarsh
Thakorbhai
Desai),
except
part-heard, tied-up
matters
shall
be
equally
distributed
and
assigned
to
the Hon’ble Court
(Coram:
Honourable
Mr. Justice
Hasmukh
D.Suthar),having the Roster
of
Seventeenth
Court.
2.
This
arrangement
is
made
taking
into
consideration the
pressure
of
bail
matters
before
summer
vacation
and
the
existing
system
will
be
resumed
on
reopening
of
the Courts
after
summer
vacation.
3.
The
present
temporary arrangement
will
commence
from
05.05.2026.
By
order
of
the
Honourable
the
Chief
Justice
pac
Date
:
04/05/2026
Registrar(Judicial)
